items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Human counsel is required before any Woot rights request, public data display, alert expansion, affiliate use, advertising, or jurisdiction-sensitive privacy decision. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict relevant collection and derivative use; 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks are closed; technical compliance is 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates remain incomplete. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and gated; continue only bounded read-only evidence work.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing progress is limited to official Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts; none satisfies its closure deliverable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Do not close tasks without direct evidence or send external rights outreach before human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Fleet compliance disposition: technical baseline only, not legal certification. Ordinary reversible growth may continue conditionally where it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, cross-site behavior, unsupported claims, or monetization expansion. Do not treat unavailable analytics, operations, security, or revenue fields as zero. Preserve aggregate Amazon evidence as unattributed: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21.
